dipendenti = ["Ana", "Bruno", "Carla", "Diego", "Elena", "Fabio"]
turni = ["M1", "M2", "P1", "P2", "N1", "N2"]
notturni = {"N1", "N2"}

costi = {
    ("Ana", "M1"): 8, ("Ana", "M2"): 7, ("Ana", "P1"): 9, ("Ana", "P2"): 8,
    ("Bruno", "M1"): 7, ("Bruno", "M2"): 8, ("Bruno", "P1"): 8, ("Bruno", "P2"): 9,
    ("Carla", "M2"): 9, ("Carla", "P1"): 8, ("Carla", "P2"): 8,
    ("Carla", "N1"): 11, ("Carla", "N2"): 12,
    ("Diego", "M1"): 10, ("Diego", "P1"): 9, ("Diego", "P2"): 8,
    ("Diego", "N1"): 10, ("Diego", "N2"): 11,
    ("Elena", "M1"): 8, ("Elena", "M2"): 10, ("Elena", "P1"): 9,
    ("Elena", "P2"): 9, ("Elena", "N1"): 12, ("Elena", "N2"): 10,
    ("Fabio", "M1"): 9, ("Fabio", "M2"): 8, ("Fabio", "P1"): 10, ("Fabio", "P2"): 7,
}

m = gp.Model("M03")
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0

x = {}
for i in dipendenti:
    for j in turni:
        if (i, j) in costi:
            x[i, j] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name=f"x_{i}_{j}")

m.setObjective(
    gp.quicksum(costi[i, j] * x[i, j] for (i, j) in x),
    GRB.MINIMIZE
)

for j in turni:
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for i in dipendenti if (i, j) in x) == 1, name=f"turno_{j}")

for i in dipendenti:
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in turni if (i, j) in x) <= 2, name=f"max_turni_{i}")
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in notturni if (i, j) in x) <= 1, name=f"max_notte_{i}")

m.optimize()

if m.Status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
    status = "OPTIMAL"
    objective = float(m.ObjVal)
    variables = {v.VarName: v.X for v in m.getVars()}
else:
    status = {
        GRB.INFEASIBLE: "INFEASIBLE",
        GRB.UNBOUNDED: "UNBOUNDED",
        GRB.INF_OR_UNBD: "INF_OR_UNBD",
        GRB.ITERATION_LIMIT: "ITERATION_LIMIT",
        GRB.NODE_LIMIT: "NODE_LIMIT",
        GRB.TIME_LIMIT: "TIME_LIMIT",
        GRB.SOLUTION_LIMIT: "SOLUTION_LIMIT",
        GRB.INTERRUPTED: "INTERRUPTED",
        GRB.NUMERIC: "NUMERIC",
        GRB.SUBOPTIMAL: "SUBOPTIMAL",
    }.get(m.Status, str(m.Status))
    objective = None
    variables = {}

risultato = {"status": status, "objective": objective, "variables": variables}
print("SOLUTION_JSON=" + json.dumps(risultato, ensure_ascii=False))
```
